meta.prompt_suffix: Style: candid documentary photograph of a real place, not an advertisement, not CGI, not a composite. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at about f/2.8, standing eye level, available light only, true-to-life restrained colour, mild sensor noise, a slight handheld tilt, honest texture on skin, wood, paper, glass and metal. Screens, printers and appliance panels may be genuinely backlit exactly as they are in real life, but the photograph itself is never post-processed — no bloom, no rim light, no lens flare, no HDR look, no hyper-saturation, no glowing halo around anything. Apart from the Korean and English text quoted above, no other words, numbers or letterforms appear anywhere in the picture — every other sheet, label, sign and screen row is blank or printed too small and slightly out of focus to read; no english text, no latin letters, no fake chinese characters, no gibberish, no invented words, and no company name, ticker symbol or calendar date anywhere. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [A 얼굴] 나 같은 사람(계좌가 물린 50대 초 월급쟁이) — 특수직업·다른세대·성공자 아님 / [B 금액] 모니터 계좌 화면의 "-931만 원"·"-9,310,000원" / [C 사건] 잔액이 1초 전에 갱신돼 차트선이 아직 그려지는 중 / [D 주어] 손해 보는 건 내 계좌다 / [구도] 인물클로즈업 — 처음으로 총손익을 확인하는 순간의 표정이 곧 정보라 얼굴이 일을 한다(§2-A-0) / [텍스트] 제목은 「4단계의 이름」, 썸네일은 「그 끝의 값」 — 근거: verified-data 1절 NH 잔고보유 240만 1,502명 중 54.6% 손실·1인 평균 -931만 원
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark shoulder of the man nearest the camera and the shadowed edge of the dining table, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, hand, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. Counters and table tops run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge, and anything resting on them sits at mid height. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the man is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right. The monitor beside him is far smaller, its screen about one third of the frame width. Photographed from across the dining table of an ordinary Korean apartment living room on an overcast late afternoon, camera at standing eye level, soft daylight coming from a balcony window on the left. On the left of the frame a desktop monitor stands face-on at mid height and its account app is the brightest rectangle in the picture: a bright white interface with a small header line reading "내 계좌 평가손익" in Korean Hangul, below it one large red figure reading "-931만 원" whose characters are each about one twelfth of the frame height, and under that a smaller line reading "-9,310,000원"; a thin red line chart is still being drawn across the panel and the lowest list rows are still empty, because the balance refreshed one second ago. Around it sit the honest props of a lived-in home — a stainless cup, a torn wall-calendar page taped to the wall, tangled charger cables, worn varnish on the table top, a folded pair of reading glasses. The man is Korean, in his early fifties, in a stretched grey T-shirt; his eyes are wide open showing the whites, his flat palm is clamped hard over his own mouth, his other hand is still resting on the mouse he has just clicked, and his cheeks are flushed.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [A 얼굴] 없음 — 물건과 화면이 주인공이라 얼굴을 지워도 메시지가 안 사라진다(§2-A-0) / [B 금액] 노트북 "2,000만 원"·"20,000,000원" + 콜아웃 안 "20,000,000원" / [C 사건] 매수 확인 버튼을 지금 누르는 중, 대출 승인 알림이 방금 떴다 / [D 주어] 내 마이너스통장에서 나간 내 돈 / [구도] 화면클로즈업 / [텍스트] 제목이 못 말한 「2단계 물 타기의 실제 금액」 — 근거: verified-data 8-1절 마이너스통장 2,000만 원으로 물타기를 시작한 사례. 폰은 원래 작은 물건이라 확대 콜아웃을 쓰고 폰 자체는 자연 크기로 둔다

The laptop shows a bright white brokerage interface: a small header reading "추가 매수" in Korean Hangul, under it one large figure reading "2,000만 원", under that a smaller line reading "20,000,000원", and a confirm button that a bare fingertip is pressing down right now, the button already darkened under the press. One single circular magnified inset sits in the upper right quarter of the frame, about one third of the frame width, ringed with a thick red border: inside it the same phone screen appears enlarged and sharp, reading "마이너스통장 승인" in Korean Hangul with "20,000,000원" beneath it, and one thick red arrow runs from that circle down to the phone. A desk printer is still turning and is feeding out one long unbroken strip of transaction history that runs forward across the desk and over its front edge toward the camera, the individual rows printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Behind the printer the monitor shows a bright white account screen: a small header reading "총손익" in Korean Hangul, under it one large red figure reading "-931만 원" whose characters are each about one twelfth of the frame height, under that a smaller line reading "-9,310,000원", and the lowest list rows still empty. Taped to the wall above the monitor is a sheet of paper handwritten in thick black marker, its top line reading "원금 오면 판다" in Korean Hangul with a smaller English line beneath reading "Wait For Break-even". The room carries the honest wear of a real house — a swivel chair with cracked vinyl, a dusty power strip, a stainless cup holding pens, a wall socket with three plugs crammed in.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 내가 환호하는 바로 그 순간에, 같은 화면 안의 누군가는 이미 정리하고 걸어 나가고 있다 / [남김] 좌우 A vs B 화면 분할(다수 vs 단독) · 3요소 계층 텍스트 자리(상단 라벨·중단·하단을 비워 둔 구성) · 어두운 화면 안의 빨강 포인트 · 카메라 시점 정면·눈높이 와이드 / [바꿈] 피사체 진영(세력 vs 개미 → 판 사람 vs 안 판 사람, 둘 다 같은 개인 투자자) · 광원(네이비 트레이딩룸 → 집 안 책상의 자연광 다큐 톤) · 강조 요소(빨간 하락 화살표·출구 표지판 → 원 단위 금액 두 개가 각 화면에 실물로) / [A 얼굴] 나 같은 사람 여럿, 좌우대비라 얼굴 55~60% 미적용 / [B 금액] 좌 "-931만 원"·"-9,310,000원" / 우 "+912만 원"·"+9,120,000원" / [C 사건] 좌는 지금 환호하며 화면을 찍는 중, 우는 지금 가방을 메고 걸어 나가는 중 / [D 주어] 둘 다 내 계좌의 두 갈래 결말 / [구도] 좌우대비 — 글자를 다 지워도 어두운 방과 볕 든 방으로 이긴 쪽이 갈린다(§3-A-1) — 근거: verified-data ★절 NH 평가손익 -931만 원 vs 신한 실현손익 +912만 원
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark backs and shoulders of the two people nearest the camera, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, hand, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: this is a two-world split frame, so no single face fills more than about one fifth of the frame height and nobody blocks either side; the sliding-door frame that divides the two rooms runs vertically straight down the middle of the picture. Photographed straight on at standing eye level from the middle of an ordinary Korean apartment, a wide shot that holds both rooms in one frame. LEFT WORLD, dim: the curtain is drawn and the only light is the laptop screen; three people in their forties and fifties are crowded around one laptop on a low desk, laughing with their arms up and their own phones raised to photograph the screen. The laptop shows a bright white account app whose large red figure reads "-931만 원", with a smaller line reading "-9,310,000원" and a small green "+2.4%" beside it — it went up today, the total is still red. Around them: a tower of stacked paper cups, a fallen pill sachet, delivery boxes shoved under the desk. thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark backs and shoulders of the people seated nearest the camera, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, hand, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The kitchen table runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: this is a two-world split frame framed at chest height, so no single face fills more than about one quarter of the frame height and nobody blocks either side; the glass balcony door frame that divides the two worlds runs vertically down the middle of the picture. Photographed straight on at standing eye level in an ordinary Korean apartment kitchen. LEFT WORLD, gloomy behind half-drawn curtains: four people in their late forties and early fifties sit close around the kitchen table, fists going up in the air, all of them leaning over one tablet propped against a cup; the tablet shows a bright white account app with a large red figure reading "-931만 원" and a smaller line reading "-9,310,000원". Detail: a leaning tower of paper cups, a saucer full of curled receipts, a cardigan sliding off a chair back, crumbs on the table. RIGHT WORLD, bright: past the glass door, clear morning light floods the balcony, and a woman in her early fifties seen from behind is pushing that door open and stepping out with a folded laptop under one arm; the phone in her other hand is angled just enough toward the camera to show a green figure reading "+912만 원" with a smaller line reading "+9,120,000원". Laundry hangs in the sunlight beyond her. The faces on the left have eyes squeezed shut with laughter and mouths wide open; the woman leaving is seen from behind, shoulders dropped and loose.
